title: Chapter 89: Fighting For Interests
content:
Chapter 89: Fighting For Interests

After the war, the Zerg Puppies and the Tengu Clan soldiers met on the battlefield. These warriors who survived the bloody battle looked at each other and retreated silently.

The last 100,000 evil god troops, the vast majority of them disappeared in the end, which can be said to have made Wu Qing a lot of money.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network → digit𝚠𝚔ｇ𝚗.𝚌═𝚖]

The battlefield was in a mess, the scene was horrible, and it was about to get dark, and there was no time to clean up the battlefield.

At night, the battlefield became a weird paradise, and no one knew what terrible things would happen.

How to deal with this situation, Wu Qing was at a loss, he had never left a corpse when he fought in this world, and he had never encountered the current situation.

Therefore, he decisively ordered the Zerg to withdraw from the battlefield and handed it over to the Tengu Clan to deal with.

The battlefield can be handed over to the Tengu clan, but there is a place that Wu Qing wants to fight for, that is the camp of the evil god camp, where there are still a lot of combat supplies, which is a huge fortune.

More than 50,000 Zerg troops quickly gathered into a black torrent and rushed towards the city in the middle of the evil god camp.

Wu Qing directly gave up the military camp outside the city where the evil god camp was located and the small territories where the garrisons were stationed in the surrounding areas. The number of Zerg is limited, so they can only choose the most valuable things.

The Tengu clan also saw the Zerg's actions, but after a war, their current military strength is also limited, and they must give priority to protecting their interests on the battlefield.

The total number of troops deployed by both camps on the battlefield is close to one million, including a large number of well-equipped elite troops, and the things on each of them are valuable.

This is a world where weirdness is rampant. In some territories, weirdness will appear during the day, and some strange weirdness can even sneak into the city.

Therefore, the collection of resources is much more difficult than in the ordinary world, and the corresponding value of various resources is also much higher.

The weapons and equipment and various combat supplies left on this battlefield, if all are cleared out, will be a huge material wealth.

Originally, those things in the territory were not affected by the weirdness and could be dealt with last, but the Zerg took the biggest piece of fat first, which made the Tengu clan, who paid a huge price for this battle, unhappy.

The Tengu clan first sent a small force to occupy all the military camps and garrison territories outside the city occupied by the Zerg, and then sent people to negotiate with the Zerg, wanting to take back the spoils they believed originally belonged to them.

"Try to take it back, it's impossible, and don't really conflict."

This is the tone set by the clan elder Gou Hong.

...

The Zerg army rushed into the city where the evil god camp's army camp was located, and quickly controlled the entire city.

In the mansion in the center of the city, the Zerg found the lord's scepter. This lord's scepter is a bit special. It is in a state without lords and people, but it is bound to the territory and provides a large range of lords.

Wu Qing did not move the lord's scepter, leaving it as it was.

There are a large number of various supplies stored in the city, and there are also many believers of various races who spontaneously organized to pray to the evil god. They are all non-combat logistics personnel who followed the evil god army.

The combat power of these logistics personnel of the evil god camp is very weak. They can't play a big role if they are sent to the battlefield. The evil god camp didn't think that they would lose this war, so they were not sent to the battlefield to die.

The evil god camp was suddenly defeated because of the Zerg. The high priest evacuated in a hurry and did not make any arrangements in the city.

These non-combat evil god believers have not received training related to death battles. In the absence of the priest's leadership, they are still very docile. They only know to sit and pray, and contribute the last bit of faith energy to the evil god.

The Queen of Insects counted these people and found that there were about 50,000 people of all races. They seemed to be immersed in prayer and couldn't extricate themselves, and they didn't react to the movements of the outside world.

"Watch them all. Don't kill them unless necessary!"

Wu Qing asked the Queen of Insects to take care of these people first.

It was already late, and the new troops in the Zerg territory no longer rushed to support, but gathered on the spot in the Zerg territory.

The Zerg support team that had already set out, and all the Zergs close to the Zerg-occupied city, gathered towards the city.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone also brought Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan, and led 5,000 elite alliance troops to the city.

Wu Qing also sent a Zerg team to the territory where Niu Kun's garrison was located, where the alliance logistics troops were located, and took over the logistics personnel there.

As for Niu Kun, he led his fellow Niu people to fight the enemy, and now he is unknown whether he is alive or dead. Judging from the tragic degree of the battlefield, his hope of survival is slim.

Wu Qing has a good impression of this Niu lord, and can only hope that he will be safe.

Everything was arranged properly, and the team sent by the Tengu tribe to negotiate also arrived, this time led by Gou Yin himself.

Before Wu Qing's insect clone and Meng and others arrived, a one-star hydralisk came out to welcome the visit of the Tengu tribe. Wu Qing's consciousness possessed the one-star hydralisk and communicated with Gou Yin.

The hydralisk did not have organs to simulate human voices, and its mental power was not as strong as the host to simulate human voices. It could only communicate with others through mental power.

The one-star hydralisk, which was more than four meters tall, still had a very oppressive appearance. The Tengu people, whose height and body shape were not much different from those of humans, were just tiny in front of the one-star hydralisk.

"Please come out and see the noble lord!"

Although Gou Yin is different from other young Tengu people, he is still as proud of being a member of a big clan.

Wu Qing cannot reveal the secret that he can possess the Zerg, so he can only pretend to be a cold Zerg member to fit the image of a one-star Hydralisk.

"The lord is not here! Please tell me if you have anything to say!"

Wu Qing used his mental power to pass on the cold message through the one-star Hydralisk.

Seeing the Zerg in this state, Gou Yin knew that it was unlikely to meet the mysterious lord today.

"I came here this time to ask the nobles to give up this city. This is the spoils of war that my clan has made great sacrifices for!"

Gou Yin could only state his purpose directly.

"Without our Zerg, the city opposite would be occupied now!"

Using the identity of the Zerg, Wu Qing would not be so polite when speaking, which is in line with the image of the Hydralisk.

After hearing this, although it was almost the truth, Gou Yin's face still changed when he said it so directly and sarcastically.

He was still not shrewd enough. If it was the elder Gou Hong who came, he would definitely not have any emotion after hearing this.

But he was much better than the other two young men of the Tengu tribe that Wu Qing had met. Although he could not keep his face calm, he could still control his emotions and he held back.
